<b>The Terrible Tyrant</b> is a [[Grand Hunt Wishes|Grand Hunt Wish]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>, which is available on the Wishwall in [[Bone Bottom]] after obtaining the [[Cling Grip]] ability. As Bone Bottom is destroyed in Act 3, this Wish is removed from the Objectives menu if uncompleted; in Act 3, the Skull Tyrant will spawn without the Wish, but will not respawn if he was already defeated.

== Wish ==
[[File:Crown Fragment.png|link=Crown Fragment|left|thumb|100x100px]]

To complete the Wish, [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]] must locate and defeat a [[Skull Tyrant]] within [[the Marrow]]. Once defeated, a [[Crown Fragment]] can be broken off its corpse with an audible crunch.

{{Gallery
| Image1 = File:Mapshot SS Bone Bottom Wishwall.png!Location of Wishwall in Bone Bottom
| Image2 = File:Mapshot SS Skull Tyrant 01.png!Location of a Skull Tyrant in the Marrow
}}

== Reward ==
[[File:Heavy Rosary Necklace.png|link=Heavy Rosary Necklace|left|thumb|100x100px]]

After defeating the Skull Tyrant and turning in the [[Crown Fragment]] to Bone Bottom's Wishwall, Hornet is rewarded with a [[Heavy Rosary Necklace]], which can be broken into {{R|220}}.

Once Hornet has killed the Skull Tyrant for the Wish, if she has reached either [[Blasted Steps]], [[The Citadel]] or [[Sinner's Road]], there is a 30% chance when resting at the Bone Bottom [[Bench (Silksong)|Bench]] for a second Skull Tyrant to rampage through Bone Bottom, destroying parts of the town.
